CustomField.formula: CASE(Per_Check_Frequency__c , "Weekly", (Admin_Fee_Per_Check__c * Total_of_Employees__c ) * 52, "Bi-weekly",(Admin_Fee_Per_Check__c * Total_of_Employees__c ) * 26, "Monthly",(Admin_Fee_Per_Check__c * Total_of_Employees__c ) * 12, "Semi Monthly",(Admin_Fee_Per_Check__c * Total_of_Employees__c ) * 24, null)
CustomField.label: Per Check Admin Fee
